description: This file defines a React component named MechanicApprovalsPage that provides an administrative UI for reviewing and approving or rejecting mechanic registration requests. It includes UI elements like tables, buttons, and badges, and relies on dataService for data fetching and updates.

methods.name: statusBadge(status)

methods.name: MechanicApprovalsPage()
methods.description: Main React component that displays a list of pending mechanics and provides approve/reject functionalities.
